description: Snapshot the page's visible interactive elements and headings (links, buttons, inputs, selects, textareas, ARIA roles, h1-h4) with stable refs e1, e2, ... and a reusable selector for each. Pass a ref to click, type, get_text, select_option, interact, or scroll instead of guessing a selector. Refs belong to this snapshot, so capture again after navigation or major page changes. Prefer this over screenshots or get_page_source to understand what is on the page.

maxElements.description: Maximum elements to return, 10-500 (default 200). Lower it on very large pages to keep the result small.

name: capture_page
